gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).
